name: dsh-inject-kit
description: Inject Kit for DeepSeek Harness: selectable AGENTS.md presets (per-session composer selector, default keeps DSH's original AGENTS.md behavior), a reusable prompt library referenced as #Name in the composer (send-time snapshot replacement), and per-session system-identity overrides (replace or remove the fixed harness identity section via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall, effective on the next message).
